name: k_best_global_assignment
qualification: not_qualified: bounded native owner-declared path-cover composition and independent tiny edge-subset oracle; no retained-source custody, identity accuracy or INT-FNX-001 qualification
tieBreak: declared link plus birth/end cost then canonical outgoing-to-incoming assignment tuple, unassigned last
complexityWitness: input bytes, complete pair dispositions, certified Murty operations and complete path-cover checks
outputSizeWitness: all tracklets and pair dispositions, exact implicit family, all-singletons, displayed prefix and complete certified assignment output
objective: minimize declared chosen-link cost plus a birth price per path start and an end price per path end; preserve every tracklet exactly once, including unsupported singletons
reduction: each tracklet supplies one outgoing left item and one incoming right item; full-interval strictly forward admitted edges form a DAG; priced unassigned left/right items are path ends/starts; unchanged certified Hungarian/Murty kernels produce the ordered prefix
numericPolicy: signed i64 inclusive capture endpoints in a declared common clock/time unit; exact i128 gap subtraction; nonnegative u64 inclusive transit bounds and costs in a separate explicit unit; checked u64 materialized path totals; any overflow refuses the complete result
timeRule: require 0 < target.start.min - source.end.max, that minimum >= transit.min, and target.start.max - source.end.min <= transit.max; this conservative Cartesian endpoint test covers every locally valid start<=end choice and makes wider intervals only remove edges
familyRule: all subsets of the complete admitted DAG with at most one incoming and one outgoing edge per original member; this is an exact implicit family of disjoint paths covering every member, including the explicitly materialized all-singleton cover
prefixRule: displayed alternatives are exactly the requested first k assignments in objective/canonical tuple order; displayed_prefix_complete is true only when fewer than k exist; equality at k is not an exhaustion certificate
constraints: one owner-declared property/session/privacy/analysis-generation/clock scope, not authenticated permission or custody
all source, camera, calibration, model and transition-basis handles are nonzero ordinary content digests and remain input-bound
different model generations cannot be joined; same-camera handoffs also require identical camera and calibration generations
missing, invalidated and redacted support disables incident edges while preserving the original tracklet as a singleton
every ordered non-self pair receives a complete disposition with all applicable reasons; undeclared pairs are forbidden
every displayed path cover is checked for all-member coverage, admitted links, in/out uniqueness, boundaries and exact objective components
preparation, all certified assignment operations, full solver proof and complete result rows share the declared budget
cancellation and exhaustion return no prefix, truncated family or partial witness
counterVariables: n is the original tracklet count, m the complete declared transition count, k the requested prefix; the child assignment has 2*n items and no more than m allowed pairs

dominantCounterBounds.assignment_operations: sum of unchanged assignment::multimatch_bound(2*n,m,k) operation rows

compatibility: additive ALG-MULTIMATCH-001 mode; uncancelled successful legacy optimal_assignment and k_best_assignments identities, counters, outputs and witness bytes are unchanged by the borrowed cancellation wrappers
noClaims: confirmed physical person or persistent identity
probability, calibrated confidence or measured objective cost
source custody, source content validation or owner authority from a digest alone
per-exposure duplication detection or multi-view simultaneous visibility fusion
permission to change tracks, activate a camera, disclose evidence or perform an effect
